scope: template source and generated Canvas resource only

artifact_access.gap: Runtime routes resolve content through a run ID plus artifact_names or artifact_name; the Canvas MCP View has no caller-owned Workspace/application/revision binding resolver to authorize a selected artifact.
artifact_access.template_behavior: No artifact handle, fetch, status, or success claim is emitted.

successful_search_shape.reason: The shared QueryResults Success schema requires a non-null Artifact.handle; this template has no authorized artifact resolver.

core_dependency.required_gate: Publish Core 1.0.3, then verify fresh dependency resolution and published-wheel compatibility before exposing this production template.
core_dependency.evidence_limit: Current source-based acceptance does not prove the published wheel or packaged/frozen Action Server.
